nodes.name: Harmonic Range
nodes.description:
When Baizhi casts Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, You'tan generates a field of Euphonia that lasts for 15s.
Euphonia
ATK of the Resonators who pick up Euphonia is increased by 15% for 20s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Emergency Plan cria Euphonia por 15s. Quem a recolhe recebe 15% de ATQ por 20s.

nodes.name: Stimulus Feedback
nodes.description: Baizhi's Heavy Attack on hit heals the character with the lowest HP on a nearby team by 0.25% of her Max HP.
nodes.descriptionPt: Ao acertar um ataque pesado, cura o personagem com menos PV de uma equipe próxima em 0,25% dos PV máximos de Baizhi.

nodes.name: Perfect Performance
nodes.description: Aalto's Heavy Attack will always critically hit, triggered once every 30s.
nodes.descriptionPt: O ataque pesado sempre causa acerto crítico. Pode ativar uma vez a cada 30s.

nodes.name: Mid-game Break
nodes.description: Aalto will continuously recover STA when he is in the Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash state.
nodes.descriptionPt: Recupera stamina continuamente durante Mistcloak Dash, do Circuito Forte.

nodes.name: Before All Sounds
nodes.description: In Instant Response, Heavy Attack - Aemeath and Heavy Attack - Mech gain 200% DMG Amplification.
nodes.descriptionPt: Durante Instant Response, os ataques pesados de Aemeath e do Mech recebem 200% de amplificação de dano.

nodes.name: Between the Stars
nodes.description:
In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, when Resonators in the team inflict Tune Rupture - Shifting or deal Tune Rupture DMG, Aemeath's Crit. DMG increases by 20%, up to 3 times. Each Resonator can only trigger this effect once.
With 3 stacks, Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Finale DMG is Amplified by 25%.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.
In Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, when Resonators in the team inflict Fusion Burst, Aemeath's Crit. DMG increases by 30%, up to 2 times. Each Resonator can only trigger this effect once.
With 2 stacks, Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Finale DMG is Amplified by 25%.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.
nodes.descriptionPt: No modo Tune Rupture, cada aliado que aplica Tune Rupture - Shifting ou causa dano de Tune Rupture concede 20% de Dano CRIT, até 3 acúmulos. No modo Fusion Burst, cada aliado que aplica Fusion Burst concede 30%, até 2 acúmulos. Cada personagem ativa uma vez. No máximo de acúmulos, Heavenfall Edict: Finale recebe 25% de amplificação de dano. Trocar o modo ou adicionar personagens à equipe reinicia o efeito.

nodes.name: Glory's Favor
nodes.description: When Augusta deals damage, she gains a shield equal to 350 + 2.5% of her Max HP for 5s, triggered once every 0.5s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
nodes.descriptionPt: Ao causar dano, recebe um escudo de 350 + 2,5% dos PV máximos por 5s. Ativa a cada 0,5s; não acumula nem é transferido ao trocar de personagem.

nodes.name: Blazing Valor
nodes.description:
When Augusta is out of combat for over 4s, she gains the following effects that can be triggered once every 4s:
- If Majesty is less than 1 stack, restore 1 stack.
- Fully restore Crown of Wills.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após mais de 4s fora de combate, recupera 1 Majesty se tiver menos de 1 e restaura completamente Crown of Wills. Ativa a cada 4s.

nodes.name: Voyager's Blaze
nodes.description: Healing provided by Waves of Acclaims is increased by 20%.
nodes.descriptionPt: A cura de Waves of Acclaims aumenta em 20%.

nodes.name: Trial by Fire and Tide
nodes.description: Brant's resistance to interruption is increased during Mid-air Attacks and gains 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.
nodes.descriptionPt: Durante ataques aéreos, aumenta a resistência à interrupção e concede 15% de bônus de dano Fusion.

nodes.name: Seedbed
nodes.description: Gain 15% Havoc DMG Bonus. DMG dealt by Heavy Attack Pruning is now considered Basic Attack DMG.
nodes.descriptionPt: Concede 15% de bônus de dano Havoc. O dano do ataque pesado Pruning passa a ser considerado dano de ataque básico.

nodes.name: Epiphyte
nodes.description: Gain 15% Basic DMG Bonus. Gain increased resistance to interruption when casting Basic Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, and Basic Attack Blazing Waltz.
nodes.descriptionPt: Concede 15% de bônus de dano de ataque básico e aumenta a resistência à interrupção durante ataques básicos, Vining Waltz e Blazing Waltz.

nodes.name: Time Arrives, Evil Declines
nodes.description: Buling gains 25% Healing Bonus when restoring HP for Resonators with less than 50% HP.
nodes.descriptionPt: Recebe 25% de bônus de cura ao curar personagens com menos de 50% dos PV.

nodes.name: Earthly Immortal is Here!
nodes.description: Targets damaged by Intro Skill - Summon and Smite obtain 4 stacks of Electro Flare. This effect is triggered once every 10s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Alvos atingidos pela Intro Summon and Smite recebem 4 acúmulos de Electro Flare. Ativa uma vez a cada 10s.

nodes.name: Bloodshed Awaken
nodes.description: Casting Heavy Attack Mercy gives Calcharo 10% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar o ataque pesado Mercy concede 10% de bônus de dano da Liberação de Ressonância por 15s.

nodes.name: Revenant Rush
nodes.description: When Heavy Attack "Death Messenger" hits the target, the damage taken by Calcharo is reduced by 15% for 5s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Ao acertar Death Messenger, o dano recebido diminui em 15% por 5s.

nodes.name: "Cure"
nodes.descriptionPt: Aumenta o bônus de cura em 20%.

nodes.name: "Poison"
nodes.description: Casting Echo Skill gives 6% Havoc DMG Bonus for 10s, stacking up to 2 times.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar uma habilidade de Eco concede 6% de bônus de dano Havoc por 10s, até 2 acúmulos.

nodes.name: Flawless Purity
nodes.description:
After casting Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor, Carlotta can perform Mid-air Attacks while being immune to any DMG or interruptions before the Mid-air Attack deals DMG.
When Carlotta is on the team, the active Resonator's Flight STA cost is reduced by 20%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após Chromatic Splendor, pode executar ataques aéreos com imunidade a dano e interrupção até o ataque causar dano. Com Carlotta na equipe, o personagem ativo gasta 20% menos stamina em voo.

nodes.name: Ars Gratia Artis
nodes.description: Intro Skill Wintertime Aria, Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor, Resonance Liberation Death Knell, and Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion can inflict Deconstruction.
nodes.descriptionPt: Wintertime Aria, Chromatic Splendor, Death Knell e Imminent Oblivion podem aplicar Deconstruction.

nodes.name: Secret Strategist
nodes.description: When casting Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest or Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge, each stack of Enflamement will increase Fusion DMG Bonus by 5%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Ao usar True Sight - Conquest ou True Sight - Charge, cada acúmulo de Enflamement aumenta o bônus de dano Fusion em 5%.

nodes.name: Sweeping Force
nodes.description: Casting Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice or Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty gives 20% Fusion DMG Bonus and ignores 15% of the target's DEF when dealing damage.
nodes.descriptionPt: Flaming Sacrifice e Radiance of Fealty concedem 20% de bônus de dano Fusion e ignoram 15% da DEF do alvo ao causar dano.

nodes.name: A Heart's Truest Wishes
nodes.description: The healing received by all Resonators other than Cartethyia/Fleurdelys in the team is increased by 20% and their resistance to interruption is enhanced. If Rover: Aero is in the team, Rover: Aero additionally restores 25 Windstrings upon casting Omega Storm.
nodes.descriptionPt: Os demais personagens da equipe recebem 20% mais cura e maior resistência à interrupção. Rover Aero recupera ainda 25 Windstrings ao usar Omega Storm.

nodes.name: Wind's Indelible Imprint
nodes.description: Targets with 1 to 3 stacks of Aero Erosion take 30% more DMG from Cartethyia and Fleurdelys. Targets with more than 3 stacks of Aero Erosion additionally take 10% more DMG from Cartethyia and Fleurdelys for each stack of Aero Erosion they have, up to 3 stacks.
nodes.descriptionPt: Alvos com 1–3 acúmulos de Aero Erosion recebem 30% mais dano de Cartethyia/Fleurdelys. Cada acúmulo acima de 3 aumenta esse dano em mais 10%, até 3 acúmulos adicionais.

nodes.name: Inescapable Fate
nodes.description: When a Resonator in the team defeats a target marked by Unseen Snare, the Cooldown of Chisa's Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling is reset, triggered up to once every 3s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Quando a equipe derrota um alvo marcado por Unseen Snare, reinicia a recarga de Eye of Unraveling. Ativa a cada 3s.

nodes.name: All Ends Here
nodes.description:
Casting Intro Skill Reverberance - Return or Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility grants 20% Havoc DMG Bonus and 20% Healing Bonus for 12s.
When Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane defeat a target marked by Unseen Snare, Chisa gains Sight of Unraveling, lasting 3s.
While in Sight of Unraveling, Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare that lasts for 30s on the targets damaged by Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane.
nodes.descriptionPt: Reverberance - Return ou Moment of Nihility concedem 20% de bônus de dano Havoc e 20% de bônus de cura por 12s. Quando um aliado com Thread of Bane derrota um alvo com Unseen Snare, Chisa recebe Sight of Unraveling por 3s: durante esse efeito, o dano desses aliados aplica Unseen Snare por 30s.

nodes.name: Scorching Magazine
nodes.description: Max Thermobaric Bullets is increased by 10 rounds. The damage of Resonance Skill Boom Boom is increased by 50%.
nodes.descriptionPt: A capacidade de Thermobaric Bullets aumenta em 10. O dano de Boom Boom aumenta em 50%.

nodes.name: Numbingly Spicy!
nodes.description: Each Thermobaric Bullet that hits a target during Resonance Skill DAKA DAKA! increases ATK by 1% for 10s, stacking up to 30 times.
nodes.descriptionPt: Cada Thermobaric Bullet que acerta durante DAKA DAKA! aumenta o ATQ em 1% por 10s, até 30 acúmulos.

nodes.name: Interlude Tune
nodes.description: Casting Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza grants Ciaccona a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. Switching out Ciaccona removes the Shield.
nodes.descriptionPt: Singer's Triple Cadenza concede um escudo de 100% dos PV máximos por 4s. O escudo desaparece ao trocar de personagem.

nodes.name: Winds of Rinascita
nodes.description: Increase Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat's DMG by 30%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Aumenta o dano de Quadruple Downbeat em 30%.

nodes.name: Crimson Light
nodes.description: Damage of Resonance Skill Crimson Erosion triggered by Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades is increased by 20%. The HP cost and stacks of Ruby Blossom recovered are doubled.
nodes.descriptionPt: Crimson Erosion ativado por Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades causa 20% mais dano. O custo de PV e os acúmulos recuperados de Ruby Blossom são dobrados.

nodes.name: Overflow
nodes.description: After casting the Resonance Skill Sanguine Pulse, Danjin's Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 30% for 5s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após Sanguine Pulse, o dano dos ataques pesados aumenta em 30% por 5s.

nodes.name: Vestiges of Falsehood
nodes.description: When Denia engages in combat in Stagecraft Form: restore Dark Cores to 2 if she has fewer than 2; restore Void Particle to 20 points if she has fewer than 20. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Ao entrar em combate na forma Stagecraft, restaura Dark Cores para 2 e Void Particle para 20 caso estejam abaixo desses valores. Ativa a cada 12s.

nodes.name: Etched Colors
nodes.description:
While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains the following effects based on her current Resonance Mode:
- Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst: All Resonators in the team gain 30% Fusion DMG Bonus.
- Resonance Mode - Tune Strain: All Resonators in the team gain 10 Tune Break Boost. When a Resonator in the team has an Off-Tune Buildup Rate over 100%, every 10% that runs over increases the Resonator's Tune Break Boost by 8, up to 40.
nodes.descriptionPt: Durante Entropy Shift: no modo Fusion Burst, toda a equipe recebe 30% de bônus de dano Fusion. No modo Tune Strain, recebe 10 Tune Break Boost; cada 10% de Off-Tune Buildup Rate acima de 100% concede mais 8, até 40 adicionais.

nodes.name: Angry Cosmos
nodes.description: During the Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, when Encore's HP is above 70%, DMG dealt is increased by 10%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Durante Cosmos Rave, causa 10% mais dano enquanto estiver acima de 70% dos PV.

nodes.name: Woolies Cheer Dance
nodes.description: When Resonance Skill Flaming Woolies or Resonance Skill Cosmos - Rampage is cast, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 10% for 10s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Flaming Woolies ou Cosmos - Rampage concedem 10% de bônus de dano Fusion por 10s.

nodes.name: Fine Snow
nodes.description:
When a Resonator in the team applies Glacio Chafe or Havoc Bane, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of Snow Rust. Snow Rust stacks up to 3 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of Snow Rust, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
2 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier of 102%.
3 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is additionally Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.
nodes.descriptionPt: Cada personagem que aplica Glacio Chafe ou Havoc Bane concede 1 Snow Rust, uma vez por personagem, até 3. Com 1 acúmulo: +40% de Dano CRIT e, enquanto Hiyuki está ativa, +30% de amplificação de Glacio Bite nos alvos próximos. Com 2: cada Glacio Chafe aplicado por ela ativa Glacio Bite com multiplicador fixo de 102%. Com 3: mais 30% de amplificação de Glacio Bite enquanto ativa. Adicionar personagens à equipe reinicia o efeito.

nodes.name: Ephemeral Realm
nodes.description: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of Snowforged Blade, restore 1 point.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após sair do combate ou recuperar-se de um nocaute, permanecer 4s fora de combate restaura 1 Snowforged Blade se tiver menos de 1.

nodes.name: Oathbound Hunt
nodes.description:
1 stack of Fated End is inflicted on the target when the following skills hit: Intro Skill, Basic Attack, Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Dodge Counter, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack, Hellstride, Resonance Skill - Encroach, Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice, Resonance Skill - Ravage and Resonance Liberation, up to 4 stacks. Each stack Amplifies the DMG directly dealt by Galbrena's Normal Attack, Resonance Skill, Forte Circuit, Resonance Liberation, Intro Skill, and Outro Skill by 5% for 5.5s. The same type of skill can trigger this effect on the same target once every 5s.
Resonance Skill - Encroach and Resonance Skill - Ravage are considered the same type of skill.
nodes.descriptionPt: Intro, ataques básicos, Seraphic Execution, contra-ataque, Volley of Death, Flamewing Verdict, ataque aéreo, Hellstride, Encroach, Ascent of Malice, Ravage e Liberação aplicam Fated End ao acertar. Até 4 acúmulos: cada um amplifica em 5% o dano direto de seus ataques normais, habilidade, Circuito, Liberação, Intro e Outro por 5,5s. Cada tipo de golpe ativa uma vez por alvo a cada 5s; Encroach e Ravage contam como o mesmo tipo.

nodes.name: Sin Feaster
nodes.description: Casting Basic Attack  Stage 4, Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 3, and Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 3 recovers 10 points of STA.
nodes.descriptionPt: Recupera 10 de stamina ao usar: ataque básico 4, Seraphic Execution 5, Volley of Death 3 ou Flamewing Verdict 3.

nodes.name: Formless Release
nodes.description: Damage of Resonance Liberation Purification Force Field is increased by 20%.
nodes.descriptionPt: O dano de Purification Force Field aumenta em 20%.

nodes.name: Reflection
nodes.description: The Shield obtained from Heavy Attack Primordial Chi Spiral is increased by 20%.
nodes.descriptionPt: O escudo de Primordial Chi Spiral aumenta em 20%.

nodes.name: Radiant Surge
nodes.descriptionPt: Concede 20% de bônus de dano Spectro.

nodes.name: Converged Flash
nodes.description: DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill Loong's Halo is increased by 50%.
nodes.descriptionPt: O multiplicador de dano da Intro Loong's Halo aumenta em 50%.

nodes.name: Waxing Ascent
nodes.description: Every time Iuno casts Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, or Intro Skill, she gains 1 Shield equal to 32% of her ATK for 15s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar ataque básico, pesado, contra-ataque, habilidade, Liberação ou Intro concede um escudo de 32% do ATQ por 15s. Não é transferido ao trocar de personagem.

nodes.name: Derivation
nodes.description: When Iuno casts Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation, she immediately gains 5 stacks of Blessing of the Wan Light.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar Intro ou Liberação concede imediatamente 5 acúmulos de Blessing of the Wan Light.

nodes.name: Heavenly Balance
nodes.description: After casting the Intro Skill Tactical Strike, Jiyan's ATK is increased by 10% for 15s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Tactical Strike concede 10% de ATQ por 15s.

nodes.name: Tempest Taming
nodes.description: When Jiyan's attacks hit a target, Jiyan's Crit. DMG is increased by 12% for 8s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Acertar ataques concede 12% de Dano CRIT por 8s.

nodes.name: Hark the Dust
nodes.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Question the Tombs, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Earth Charm.
Earth Charm
For 15s, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, gain an unstackable Shield equal to 1.6% of Max HP + 700 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
While Jingran is in the Yinghuo state, if he is the active Resonator in the team, he gains an unstackable Shield equal to 0.8% of Max HP + 350 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
nodes.descriptionPt: Question the Tombs, Encroaching Yin ou Scorching Yang concedem Earth Charm por 15s. Enquanto Jingran está ativo, causar dano gera um escudo não cumulativo de 700 + 1,6% dos PV máximos por 5s, a cada 0,5s. Em Yinghuo, o escudo é de 350 + 0,8% dos PV máximos. Não é transferido ao trocar de personagem.

nodes.name: Trace the Vestige
nodes.description:
Upon entering combat, if Jingran's Ghost Shroud is below 25 points, restore it to 25 points. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 2 points of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
Fixation
- Upon entering combat, Jingran gains Fixation. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
- Casting Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil grants Fixation.
- When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 15 points of Ghost Shroud and removes Fixation.
nodes.descriptionPt: Ao entrar em combate, restaura Ghost Shroud para 25 se estiver abaixo disso, a cada 4s. Quando outro aliado próximo ganha escudo, recebe 2 Ghost Shroud, a cada 0,5s. Entrar em combate (a cada 4s) ou usar a Outro concede Fixation; o próximo escudo recebido por outro aliado próximo concede 15 Ghost Shroud e consome Fixation.

nodes.name: Slow Motion
nodes.description:
When Focus Ring is deployed, Lucilla slows targets within her shot.
While casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio RES of targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is reduced by 8% for 30s. If an enemy falls to Glacio Chafe DMG during this time, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, Resonators in the team gain 25% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.
These enhancements end when Lucilla switches the Resonance Mode.
nodes.descriptionPt: Com Focus Ring ativo, desacelera os alvos enquadrados. Spotlight concede por 30s: no modo Glacio Chafe, reduz em 8% a resistência Glacio de alvos próximos ao personagem ativo; mortes por Glacio Chafe contam para o personagem ativo mais próximo. No modo Echo, a equipe recebe 25% de bônus de dano de habilidade de Eco. Trocar de modo encerra esses efeitos.

nodes.name: Remembrance
nodes.description:
Film Roll can now be stacked up to 10 stacks, and Zoom up to 4 stacks.
Each time Lucilla consumes Photo when in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, she gains 2 stacks of Film Roll/1 stacks of Zoom.
nodes.descriptionPt: Film Roll passa a acumular até 10 vezes, e Zoom até 4. Consumir Photo no modo Glacio Chafe concede 2 Film Roll; no modo Echo, concede 1 Zoom.

nodes.name: Lion's Pride
nodes.description: DMG of the Intro Skill Lion Awakens is increased by 50%.
nodes.descriptionPt: O dano da Intro Lion Awakens aumenta em 50%.

nodes.name: Diligent Practice
nodes.description: Under the Forte Circuit Striding Lion state, within 3s after each Basic Attack, the next Forte Circuit Mountain Roamer will deal an additional Glacio DMG, equal to 150% of Mountain Roamer DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
nodes.descriptionPt: Em Striding Lion, nos 3s após cada ataque básico, o próximo Mountain Roamer causa dano Glacio adicional equivalente a 150% do dano de Mountain Roamer. Conta como dano de Habilidade de Ressonância.

nodes.name: Pathfinding
nodes.description: Gain 10% Electro DMG Bonus when in Red Light Mode.
nodes.descriptionPt: Concede 10% de bônus de dano Electro no modo Red Light.

nodes.name: Expediting
nodes.description: Casting Energized Pounce or Energized Rebound increases ATK by 10% for 5s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Energized Pounce ou Energized Rebound concedem 10% de ATQ por 5s.

nodes.name: Remember My Name
nodes.description:
After dashing for 2.5s, Lupa enters Sprint state. The next Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Starfall.
Gain increased resistance to interruptions while casting Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, and Mid-air Attack - Firestrike.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após correr por 2,5s, entra em Sprint e substitui o próximo ataque básico por Starfall. Aumenta a resistência à interrupção durante Wolf's Gnawing, Wolf's Claw e Firestrike.

nodes.name: Applause of Victory
nodes.description:
Defeating a marked target resets the cooldown of Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt.
Resonance Liberation - Glory
Casting Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory grants Glory. Within 35s:
Attacks of all Resonators in the team ignore 3% of the target's Fusion RES. For each Fusion Resonator in the team other than Lupa, this effect increases by 3%, up to the maximum of 9%. When there are 3 Fusion Resonators in the team, Resonators' attacks further ignore 6% Fusion RES.
nodes.descriptionPt: Derrotar um alvo marcado reinicia a recarga de Shewolf's Hunt. Fire-Kissed Glory concede Glory por 35s: a equipe ignora 3% da resistência Fusion, mais 3% por aliado Fusion além de Lupa, até 9%. Com 3 personagens Fusion, ignora mais 6%.

nodes.name: Ghost Cyberware
nodes.description:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. Max 1 stacks by default.
Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 0.5s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Enquanto ativa, ficar 8s sem receber dano concede 1 Optical Illusion, com limite inicial de 1. Ao ser atacada, anula 100% daquele dano, recupera-se imediatamente de impacto ou lançamento e, se estiver no chão, ativa uma esquiva bem-sucedida. Consome 1 acúmulo; ativa a cada 0,5s.

nodes.name: Function Cracking
nodes.description:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.
Network Backdoor
Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.
nodes.descriptionPt: Payload, Pulse Interference ou Deadlock marcam chefes Overlord/Calamity por 2min. Se a equipe derrotar o alvo marcado com dano direto, Lucy e Rebecca (se presente) recebem Network Backdoor por 2min: 10% de amplificação de todo dano e +10% ao multiplicador de Hack por acúmulo, até 2. Com 2, acrescenta mais 5% a ambos. O efeito fica inválido e não pode ser obtido enquanto Lucy estiver nocauteada.

nodes.name: Pulses Under the Snow
nodes.description:
When Resonators in the team directly damage and defeat targets, if the targets are affected by Tune Strain - Interfered:
- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered.
- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's Tune Strain - Interfered stacks.
Perpetuating Daytime
- When Resonators in the team casts Tune Break, if the target is affected by Tune Strain - Shifting,  Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, up to the target's current Tune Strain - Interfered stack cap. Cooldown: 1s.
Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime and will not be able to obtain any new stacks when knocked out.
- Perpetuating Daytime stacks up to 2 times.
nodes.descriptionPt: Quando a equipe derrota com dano direto um alvo com Tune Strain - Interfered, guarda seus acúmulos em Perpetuating Daytime, até 2; só substitui um valor existente se o novo for maior. Ao usar Tune Break em um alvo com Tune Strain - Shifting, consome o estoque e aplica o mesmo número de Interfered, respeitando o limite do alvo. Recarga de 1s. Perde os acúmulos e não pode recebê-los enquanto nocauteado.

nodes.name: Uncaused Diagnosis
nodes.description:
When Luuk Herssen's skills directly damage targets affected by Tune Strain - Interfered, every 10 points of Tune Break Boost he has Amplifies this instance of damage by 5%, up to 30%.
After any nearby Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the enemies or deals Tune Break DMG, Luuk Herssen's ATK increases by 25% for 20s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Contra alvos com Tune Strain - Interfered, cada 10 Tune Break Boost amplifica seu dano direto de habilidade em 5%, até 30%. Quando um aliado próximo aplica Tune Strain - Shifting ou causa dano de Tune Break, recebe 25% de ATQ por 20s.

nodes.name: Harmonic Control
nodes.description: After casting Resonance Skill Passionate Variation, the damage of Resonance Skill Fury Fugue is increased by 25% for 8s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Passionate Variation aumenta o dano de Fury Fugue em 25% por 8s.

nodes.name: Rhythmic Vibrato
nodes.description:
During Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody, each hit of Resonance Liberation Marcato will increase the DMG of the next Resonance Liberation Marcato by 1.5%, which can be triggered once every 0.35s, stacking up to 50 times.
The effect will be reset after Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody ends.
nodes.descriptionPt: Durante Burning Rhapsody, cada acerto de Marcato aumenta o dano do próximo Marcato em 1,5%, até 50 acúmulos, a cada 0,35s. Os acúmulos acabam junto com Burning Rhapsody.

nodes.name: Blueprint
nodes.description:
Mornye's Energy Regen is increased by 10%.
Casting Intro Skill - Convergence restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3 restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Concede 10% de Recarga de Energia. Convergence e o terceiro ataque de Wide Field Observation Mode recuperam 20 de Energia Concerto, cada efeito com recarga de 20s.

nodes.name: Boundedness
nodes.description:
Casting Resonance Skill - Expectation Error or Resonance Skill - Distributed Array grants Proof of Boundedness to all Resonators in the team:
- Proof of Boundedness lasts for 60s and can be gained once every 5 min.
- When the active Resonator takes DMG greater than 30% of their Max HP, they instead take DMG equal to 30% of their Max HP. This effect can trigger up to 3 times. Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 3 times.
- When the active Resonator takes a fatal blow, they are not downed by this instance of damage. This effect can trigger up to 1 times. Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 1 times.
- When Proof of Boundedness is removed, the active Resonator restores HP equal to 150% of Mornye's DEF.
nodes.descriptionPt: Expectation Error ou Distributed Array concedem Proof of Boundedness à equipe por 60s, uma vez a cada 5min. Limita golpes acima de 30% dos PV máximos a 30%, até 3 vezes, ou impede 1 golpe fatal. Ao atingir qualquer desses limites, o efeito termina e cura o personagem ativo em 150% da DEF de Mornye.

nodes.name: Colors Never Fade!
nodes.description:
After casting Basic Attack - Visual Impact, Lynae leaves Spray Paint on the ground and continuously inflicts Photochromic Flux on targets within the Spray Paint for 5s, triggered once every 2s. When Spray Paint is on the ground, switching to another Resonance Mode doesn't affect the Photochromic Flux effects inflicted by the Spray Paint.
With Lynae in the team, the expedition motorbike's Energy Tank expands by 600 points. Lynae enters Kaleidoscopic Parade automatically while on the expedition motorbike and restores 20% of Lumiflow per second.
nodes.descriptionPt: Visual Impact deixa tinta por 5s, aplicando Photochromic Flux nos alvos da área a cada 2s; trocar o modo não altera esse efeito. Com Lynae na equipe, a moto recebe mais 600 de capacidade de energia. Enquanto pilota, entra automaticamente em Kaleidoscopic Parade e restaura 20% de Lumiflow por segundo.

nodes.name: "Adaptive Optics: Everyday Applications"
nodes.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors! increases Lynae's Spectro DMG Bonus by 25% for 9s. 
During Kaleidoscopic Parade, if Lynae isn't in combat, dodging without directional input grants her Optic Camo for 15s, which will be removed when Lynae casts any skill other than dodging or is switched off the field. Performing environmental, gameplay or functional interactions, or entering combat, removes the Optic Camo. With Optic Camo, Lynae may enter the enemy's aggro range without triggering combat.
nodes.descriptionPt: A Intro concede 25% de bônus de dano Spectro por 9s. Em Kaleidoscopic Parade e fora de combate, esquivar sem direção concede Optic Camo por 15s, permitindo entrar no alcance dos inimigos sem iniciar combate. Usar outra habilidade, trocar de personagem, interagir ou entrar em combate remove a camuflagem.

nodes.name: Presence
nodes.description: Mid-air Heavy Attack can be cast 1 more times.
nodes.descriptionPt: Permite executar o ataque pesado aéreo mais uma vez.

nodes.name: Revelation
nodes.description: When in the Absolution status and Confession status, Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 12%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Concede 12% de bônus de dano Spectro durante Absolution e Confession.

nodes.name: Accidental
nodes.description:
Casting Echo Skill grants increased resistance to interruption and reduces damage taken by 30% for 15s.
After casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, and Echo Skill, the next Volatile Note becomes Volatile Note - Cadenza.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar a habilidade de Eco aumenta a resistência à interrupção e reduz o dano recebido em 30% por 15s. Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality e a habilidade de Eco transformam a próxima Volatile Note em Volatile Note - Cadenza.

nodes.name: Octet
nodes.description:
Obtain 10 stacks of Aftersound upon entering battle. This effect cannot be triggered again within 4s after exiting the combat state. For every 1 stacks of Aftersound, Crit. DMG is increased by 2.5%.
When Aftersound reaches the max, each new stack of Aftersound increases Phrolova's Crit. DMG by 1%, up to 100%. The increased Crit. DMG is removed when Aftersound stacks are cleared.
nodes.descriptionPt: Entrar em combate concede 10 Aftersound; não pode reativar nos 4s após sair do combate. Cada acúmulo concede 2,5% de Dano CRIT. No limite de Aftersound, novos acúmulos concedem mais 1% de Dano CRIT, até 100%. O bônus adicional acaba quando Aftersound é removido.

nodes.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
nodes.description:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of Gathered Mind.
After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.
If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks will be matched to the target's Mindlock stacks.
Gathered Mind
After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.
Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Entra em combate com 1 Gathered Mind. Ao derrotar com dano direto um alvo com Mindlock, guarda seus acúmulos caso não tenha o efeito ou o alvo tenha uma quantidade igual/maior. Até 15 acúmulos por 30s. O dano da equipe aplica Mindlock igual ao estoque, uma vez por alvo. Tune Break contra um alvo com Tune Strain - Shifting aplica mais 1 Interfered, uma vez por alvo. Enquanto nocauteada, não pode obter o efeito e o estoque fica inativo.

nodes.name: To Know, To Banish
nodes.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.
Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.
nodes.descriptionPt: Stringblade, Ephemeral Transcendence (básico e contra-ataque), Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence e Billows Beneath Heaven causam 2% mais dano por Mindlock, mais 5% por acúmulo nos primeiros 7. Cada aplicação de Tune Strain - Interfered pela equipe em um chefe Overlord/Calamity aplica mais 1 Mindlock.

nodes.name: Immersive Performance
nodes.description: Casting Resonance Skill or Heavy Attack increases Roccia's ATK by 20% for 12s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar Habilidade de Ressonância ou ataque pesado concede 20% de ATQ por 12s.

nodes.name: Super Attractive Magic Box
nodes.description:
After casting Outro Skill, the Utility of the incoming Resonator is replaced with Magic Box.
Magic Box
- Upon use, pull nearby targets toward the Magic Box, dealing 100 points of Havoc DMG. This skill is considered Echo Skill that deals Utility DMG.
- The Magic Box lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.
nodes.descriptionPt: A Outro substitui a ferramenta do próximo personagem por Magic Box durante 14s ou até ele sair de campo. A caixa puxa alvos próximos e causa 100 de dano Havoc; conta como habilidade de Eco que causa dano de ferramenta.

nodes.name: Tag, You're It!
nodes.description:
ATK is increased by 10% for 12s when A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, or when Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts is cast, stacking up to 2 times. 
When a Resonator in the team inflicts Hack - Shifting, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 30 for 30s.
nodes.descriptionPt: A Girl Gets What She Wants!, Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress ou Bang-bang-bang!: Guts concedem 10% de ATQ por 12s, até 2 acúmulos. Aliados que aplicam Hack - Shifting recebem 30 Tune Break Boost por 30s.

nodes.name: Left an Opening!
nodes.description:
Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress and Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts gain increased resistance to interruption.
When Rebecca casts Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, the ATK of all nearby Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 30s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress e Bang-bang-bang!: Guts ganham resistência à interrupção. Party 'til Dawn! concede 20% de ATQ aos aliados próximos por 30s.

nodes.name: Quietude Within
nodes.description:
Qiuyuan obtains Quietude Within for 10s upon entering the Inksplash of Mind state. This effect can be triggered once every 22s.
Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, and Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice deal 50% more DMG. Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy on hit.
- This effect ends early when Qiuyuan is switched off the field.
nodes.descriptionPt: Entrar em Inksplash of Mind concede Quietude Within por 10s, a cada 22s. To Teach, To Save e To Sacrifice causam 50% mais dano; To Sacrifice também recupera 30 de Energia Concerto ao acertar. Trocar de personagem encerra o efeito.

nodes.name: Drink Away Woes Age-Old
nodes.description:
When casting Echo Skill, Qiuyuan's bamboo flask absorbs the overflowing energy and brews it into Flowing Panacea.
The next time Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained, the Flowing Panacea is consumed to gain 10% ATK increase for 20s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar uma habilidade de Eco prepara Flowing Panacea. A próxima obtenção de Swordster's Soliloquy a consome e concede 10% de ATQ por 20s.

nodes.name: Sand in the Storm
nodes.description: Casting Intro Skill Relentless Squall increases ATK by 20% for 10s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Relentless Squall concede 20% de ATQ por 10s.

nodes.name: Boundless Winds
nodes.description: Increase Healing from Resonance Liberation Omega Storm by 20%.
nodes.descriptionPt: A cura de Omega Storm aumenta em 20%.

nodes.name: Metamorph
nodes.description: In the Dark Surge state, gain 20% Havoc DMG Bonus.
nodes.descriptionPt: Concede 20% de bônus de dano Havoc durante Dark Surge.

nodes.name: Bleak Crescendo
nodes.description: While in the Dark Surge state, Basic Attack recovers 1 extra Resonance Energy when it hits a target. This effect can be triggered 1 time per second.
nodes.descriptionPt: Durante Dark Surge, acertar ataques básicos recupera 1 de Energia de Ressonância adicional, uma vez por segundo.

nodes.name: Life Entwined
nodes.description: When a Resonator other than Shorekeeper takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out and will instead be healed for 50% of Shorekeeper's HP while Shorekeeper loses the same amount of HP. Shorekeeper's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.
nodes.descriptionPt: Impede um golpe fatal em outro aliado, curando-o em 50% dos PV de Shorekeeper e retirando dela o mesmo valor, sem deixá-la abaixo de 1 PV. Ativa uma vez a cada 10min.

nodes.name: Self Gravitation
nodes.description: When the on-field Resonator is within range of a Stellarealm, Shorekeeper's Energy Regen is increased by 10%, and Rover's Energy Regen is also increased by 10% if Rover is on the team.
nodes.descriptionPt: Enquanto o personagem ativo estiver dentro de Stellarealm, Shorekeeper recebe 10% de Recarga de Energia. Rover também recebe 10% se estiver na equipe.

nodes.name: True Names Invoked
nodes.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology grants Convergent for 20s.
Convergent
The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent.
When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Convergent doesn't take effect.
nodes.descriptionPt: Solsworn Etymology concede Convergent por 20s. A próxima runa recebida gera outra do mesmo tipo e consome o efeito. Tem prioridade sobre Divergent, mas não ativa com 100 Full Stop.

nodes.name: True Names Aligned
nodes.description:
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. 
This effect resets upon a lineup change.
Blessing of Runes
Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks, Sigrika additionally gains 30% Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
For every 1% of Sigrika's Energy Regen over 125%, Sigrika gains 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for up to 50%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Cada habilidade de Eco usada por aliados próximos concede 1 Blessing of Runes, até 6; Ecos de mesmo nome ativam uma vez. Cada acúmulo concede ao personagem ativo 3% de bônus de dano Aero e de habilidade de Eco. Com 6, Sigrika recebe mais 30% de ambos. Trocar a equipe reinicia os acúmulos. Cada 1% de Recarga de Energia acima de 125% também concede 2% de bônus de dano de Eco, até 50%.

nodes.name: Reticence
nodes.description: DMG dealt by Rover's Basic Attack Resonating Echoes is increased by 60%.
nodes.descriptionPt: O dano de Resonating Echoes aumenta em 60%.

nodes.name: Silent Listener
nodes.description: Rover gains 15% ATK increase for 5s upon casting Heavy Attack Resonance.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar o ataque pesado Resonance concede 15% de ATQ por 5s.

nodes.name: Condensation
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Sanhua's Resonance Skill increased by 20% for 8s after casting her Intro Skill.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após usar a Intro, a Habilidade de Ressonância causa 20% mais dano por 8s.

nodes.name: Avalanche
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Sanhua's Forte Circuit Ice Burst is increased by 20% for 8s after casting Basic Attack 5.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após o quinto ataque básico, Ice Burst causa 20% mais dano por 8s.

nodes.name: Sky Over Water
nodes.description:
Consuming Enrichment grants the Resonator 10 stacks of Spring's Birth, up to 10 stacks. When the Resonator with Spring's Birth is not at full HP, restore their HP by 62 + 0.34% of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of Spring's Birth every 2s.
When Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring and Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade hit a target, they additionally restore 18 points of Concerto Energy and 13 points of Resonance Energy, and increase the attack's Crit. Rate by 80% and Glacio DMG by 240%. This effect can be triggered up to once every 25s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Consumir Enrichment concede 10 Spring's Birth, até 10. Se o portador não estiver com PV cheios, consome 1 a cada 2s para curar 62 + 0,34% dos PV máximos de Suisui. Awakening Spring e Tinkling Jade, ao acertarem, recuperam mais 18 de Energia Concerto e 13 de Energia de Ressonância e aumentam a Taxa CRIT do ataque em 80% e o dano Glacio em 240%, uma vez a cada 25s.

nodes.name: Glimmering Gold
nodes.description: When a Resonator other than Suisui takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out but will instead regain 50% of Suisui's current HP, while Suisui herself loses the same amount of HP. Suisui's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.
nodes.descriptionPt: Impede um golpe fatal em outro aliado e cura-o em 50% dos PV atuais de Suisui, retirando dela o mesmo valor sem deixá-la abaixo de 1 PV. Ativa uma vez a cada 10min.

nodes.name: Gift of Nature
nodes.description: When Verina casts Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms, Mid-air Attack Starflower Blooms, Resonance Liberation Arboreal Flourish or Outro Skill Blossom, all team members' ATK are increased by 20% for 20s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Starflower Blooms (pesado ou aéreo), Arboreal Flourish e Blossom concedem 20% de ATQ à equipe por 20s.

nodes.name: Grace of Life
nodes.description: Verina protects a team member from fatal damage and grants a shield with strength equal to 120% of Verina's ATK, lasting for 10s. This can be triggered 1 time every 10 minutes.
nodes.descriptionPt: Protege um aliado de dano fatal e concede um escudo de 120% do ATQ de Verina por 10s. Ativa uma vez a cada 10min.

nodes.name: Knowing
nodes.description: Gain 5% Electro DMG Bonus after casting Resonance Skill for 8s, stackable for up to 4 times.
nodes.descriptionPt: Usar a Habilidade de Ressonância concede 5% de bônus de dano Electro por 8s, até 4 acúmulos.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.description: When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation, Xiangli Yao's resistance to interruption is enhanced.
nodes.descriptionPt: Aumenta a resistência à interrupção durante Intuition, ativado pela Liberação de Ressonância.

nodes.name: Compassion
nodes.description: Yangyang recovers 30 STA after she casts a Mid-air Attack Feather Release.
nodes.descriptionPt: Feather Release recupera 30 de stamina.

nodes.name: Lazuline Mercy
nodes.description: Yangyang's Aero DMG Bonus is increased by 8% for 8s after casting Intro Skill Cerulean Song.
nodes.descriptionPt: Cerulean Song concede 8% de bônus de dano Aero por 8s.

nodes.name: Steadfast Protection
nodes.description: While Resonance Skill Rocksteady Shield lasts, the Character's DEF is increased by 15%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Enquanto Rocksteady Shield estiver ativo, a DEF do personagem aumenta em 15%.

nodes.name: Unyielding
nodes.description: After Heavy Attack Strategic Parry is successfully triggered, 25 STA is recovered.
nodes.descriptionPt: Um Strategic Parry bem-sucedido recupera 25 de stamina.

nodes.name: Unbroken Vow
nodes.description:
When a target has 1 to 3 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 10%, up to 30%.
When a target has 4 to 6 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 12%, up to 36%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Contra alvos com 1–3 Havoc Bane, cada acúmulo amplifica seu dano em 10%, até 30%. Com 4–6 Havoc Bane, cada acúmulo amplifica em 12%, até 36%.

nodes.name: One Life, One Blade
nodes.description:
Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices raises the Havoc Bane stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Windbound. Windbound can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times.
When Windbound reaches 6 stacks, Yangyang: Xuanling removes all Windbound and gains One with the Wind.
While One with the Wind lasts, when Yangyang: Xuanling casts Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, she summons Feather Release: Xuanling to attack the target, applying 6 stacks of Havoc Bane to the target. 
Windbound cannot be obtained while One with the Wind lasts.
Once Feather Release: Xuanling is summoned, the One with the Wind state is removed.
nodes.descriptionPt: Hush of a Thousand Voices eleva Havoc Bane do alvo ao máximo ao acertar. Quando aliados próximos aplicam Havoc Bane, ganha 1 Windbound por segundo, até 6. Ao chegar a 6, consome tudo e recebe One with the Wind. A próxima Sword Stance Flow: Azure ou Feather invoca Feather Release: Xuanling, aplicando 6 Havoc Bane, e encerra o efeito. Não recebe Windbound durante One with the Wind.

nodes.name: Pain Immersion
nodes.description: After using Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar, Yinlin's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 5s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Magnetic Roar concede 15% de Taxa CRIT por 5s.

nodes.name: Deadly Focus
nodes.description: The damage of Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is increased by 10% when hitting targets marked with Sinner's Mark, and Yinlin's ATK is increased by 10% for 4s when this is triggered.
nodes.descriptionPt: Lightning Execution causa 10% mais dano contra alvos com Sinner's Mark; ao ativar, Yinlin recebe 10% de ATQ por 4s.

nodes.name: Treasured Piece
nodes.description: Restore HP for all nearby party members based on 30% of the healing provided by Resonance Skill Scroll Divination when Resonance Skill Antique Appraisal is cast.
nodes.descriptionPt: Antique Appraisal cura os aliados próximos em 30% da cura de Scroll Divination.

nodes.name: Rare Find
nodes.description: Gain 15% Glacio DMG Bonus for 14s upon casting Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders.
nodes.descriptionPt: Scroll of Wonders concede 15% de bônus de dano Glacio por 14s.

nodes.name: Thunderous Determination
nodes.description: The DMG multiplier of Resonance Skill Thunder Uprising is increased by 40%, and its reduction efficiency of enemy Vibration Strength is enhanced.
nodes.descriptionPt: O multiplicador de dano de Thunder Uprising aumenta em 40%, e sua eficiência de redução da força de vibração inimiga melhora.

nodes.name: Reserved Confidence
nodes.description: The ranges of the Resonance Skills Thunder Field and Thunder Uprising are greatly expanded. When switched off the field during combat, if "Readiness" is not full, Yuanwu will automatically leave 1 Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge in place.
nodes.descriptionPt: Aumenta bastante o alcance de Thunder Field e Thunder Uprising. Ao sair de campo em combate com Readiness incompleto, deixa automaticamente 1 Thunder Wedge.

nodes.name: Calligrapher's Touch
nodes.description: When casting Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith, ATK is increased by 6% for 27s. This can be stacked up to 3 time(s).
nodes.descriptionPt: Stroke of Genius ou Creation's Zenith concedem 6% de ATQ por 27s, até 3 acúmulos.

nodes.name: Flourish
nodes.description: After Outro Skill is cast, restore 15 Resonance Energy for the incoming Resonator.
nodes.descriptionPt: Após a Outro, o próximo personagem recupera 15 de Energia de Ressonância.

nodes.name: Quick Response
nodes.description: Casting Intro Skill Immediate Execution gives 12% Spectro DMG Bonus for 14s.
nodes.descriptionPt: Immediate Execution concede 12% de bônus de dano Spectro por 14s.

nodes.name: Fear No Pain
nodes.description: When in Ready Stance, all DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
nodes.descriptionPt: Durante Ready Stance, todo dano recebido diminui em 40%.
